ei.title: Chaske's Rite of Passage in His Tribe
ei.subject: 11월_2023 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Chaske's Rite of Passage in His Tribe

fullPassage: Chaske, a Cherokee boy, was sitting on a tree stump. As a rite of passage for youths in his tribe, Chaske had to survive one night in the forest wearing a blindfold, not knowing he was observed by his father. After the sunset, Chaske could hear all kinds of noises. The wind blew the grass and shook his stump. A sense of dread swept through his body. What if wild beasts are looking at me? I can't stand this! Just as he was about to take off the blindfold to run away, a voice came in from somewhere. "I'm here around you. Don't give up, and complete your mission." It was his father's voice. He has been watching me from nearby! With just the presence of his father, the boy regained stability. What panicked him awfully a moment ago vanished into thin air.

questions.passage: Chaske, a Cherokee boy, was sitting on a tree stump. As a rite of passage for youths in his tribe, Chaske had to (A)[survive / escape] one night in the forest wearing a (B)[blindfold / costume], not knowing he was observed by his father. I can't stand this! Just as he was about to take off the blindfold to run away, a voice came in from somewhere. "I'm here around you. Don't give up, and complete your mission." It was his father's voice. He has been watching me from nearby! With just the presence of his father, the boy regained (C)[stability / instability]. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ survive — blindfold — stability: 원문 일치. 숲에서 하룻밤 살아남아야(survive) 하고, 눈가리개(blindfold)를 쓰고, 안정(stability)을 되찾음 ←정답

❌ ① instability(불안정): stability(안정)의 반의어

❌ ② escape(탈출하다): survive(살아남다)와 다른 의미

❌ ④ costume(의상): blindfold(눈가리개)와 다른 의미

det.analysis:
✅ ① dread — presence — panicked: 원문 일치. 공포감(dread)이 몸을 훑고, 아버지의 존재(presence)로 안정을 되찾으며, 공포에 빠뜨린(panicked) 것이 사라짐 ←정답

❌ ② absence(부재): presence(존재)의 반의어

❌ ③ joy(기쁨): dread(공포)의 반의어

❌ ④ calmed(진정시킨): panicked(공포에 빠뜨린)의 반의어

④ vanished(사라졌다): 공포가 '사라졌다'는 맥락에 적절 ✅

questions.passage:
(A) The darkness surrounded him completely. "I can't <u>stand</u> this!" he thought, trembling with fear.

(B) Please <u>stand</u> up when the teacher enters the classroom. It is a sign of respect.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 stand의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 참다, 견디다 / (B) 서다 ←정답

(A) 'I can't stand this'에서 stand는 '참다, 견디다'의 의미. 공포를 참을 수 없다.

(B) 'Please stand up'에서 stand는 '서다'의 의미. 선생님이 들어오면 일어서라.
det.tip: can't stand = 참을 수 없다 / stand up = 일어서다

문맥: 아버지의 존재로 안정을 되찾자, 조금 전 그를 공포에 빠뜨린 것이 ____.

✅ ④ vanished into thin air(허공으로 사라졌다): 공포가 사라졌다는 맥락에 적절 ←정답

❌ ① laughed at: 공포가 비웃는다는 건 부자연스러움

❌ ② grew stronger: 안정을 되찾은 상황과 모순

❌ ③ turned into reality: 공포 해소와 반대
det.tip: vanish into thin air = 흔적 없이 사라지다

questions.passage: Chaske, a Cherokee boy, was sitting on a tree stump. As a rite of passage for youths in his tribe, Chaske had to survive one night in the forest wearing a blindfold, not knowing he was observed by his father. After the sunset, Chaske could hear all kinds of noises. The wind blew the grass and shook his stump. A sense of dread swept through his body. What if wild beasts are looking at me? I can't stand this! Just as he was about to take off the blindfold to run away, a voice came in from somewhere. "I'm here around you. Don't give up, and __________." It was his father's voice. He has been watching me from nearby! With just the presence of his father, the boy regained stability. What panicked him awfully a moment ago vanished into thin air.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
문맥: 아버지의 목소리 — '포기하지 말고 ____하라.'

✅ ③ complete your mission(임무를 완수하라): 포기하지 말고 임무를 완수하라는 격려 ←정답

❌ ① punish the wild beasts: 아버지의 격려와 무관

❌ ② take off the blindfold: 도망치려 했던 행동과 동일하여 격려 아님

❌ ④ escape from the forest: 성인식 목적과 모순
det.tip: Don't give up, and complete your mission = 포기하지 말고 임무를 완수하라
